exposure: intra-operative wound irrigation with normal saline
outcome: surgical site infection (SSI) up to 10th post-operative day
cohort: 400 patients undergoing abdominal surgery for gynecological reasons at Pak-Emirates Military Hospital, with a mean age of 33.6 years, excluding those with known comorbidities.
finding: Intra-operative wound irrigation with normal saline significantly reduced the rate of postoperative SSIs at both 10 days (RR=0.417) and 30 days (RR=0.286) post-operation.
